audit.why: Taric has no ranged poke; Xerath's Arcanopulse/Eye of Destruction outrange Dazzle through 2+ items, matching the packet's 6-1 chart.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[6].side read 'Skill' while win[6] already reads 'Taric' — the chart contradicted itself on the last row (2+ items).
audit.why: Cosmic Radiance (180/150/120s) grants team invulnerability that nullifies Xerath's burst window once Taric hits 2 items, flipping the late stage to him.

audit.whatIsWrong: Missing interactions not reflected: Taric's Dazzle (E) can cancel a channeled Rite of the Arcane (R) on hit, and his Starlight's Touch (Q) sustain needs anti-heal timing.
audit.why: Xerath's R is a self-immobilizing channel interrupted by any CC; Dazzle stuns on landing. Starlight's Touch heals off stacked charges from Bravado-empowered autos.
audit.corrected: Folded the channel-cancel warning into report[5] and the anti-heal note into breakdown.cooldowns.

edits.before: Late support Xerath grades sieges: stun the entry, barrage the pit, relocate.
edits.after: Cosmic Radiance voids your burst at the key moment — bait it early, punish after.

edits.before: - Taric Cosmic Radiance: matchup-defining — The delayed invulnerability erases your teamfight damage — burst before it lands or wait it out. It writes your spacing rules. - E Shocking Orb is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.
edits.after: - Taric's E (Dazzle) is 16s at rank 1, down to 12s at max — punish it on cooldown, not through it. - Cosmic Radiance (R) is 180/150/120s: once burned, you get a long window to force fights. - Starlight's Touch (Q) heals off stacked charges — anti-heal timing matters.

edits.before: Q the pair from beyond answer range, W the dodge, walk — one-way ledgers per wave.
edits.after: Dazzle has a wind-up before it lands — punish the charge with Q, don't stand and eat it.

edits.before: Charging Q inside hook range — the artillery that forgets geography becomes the exhibit.
edits.after: His all-in needs stacked Bravado and a landed Dazzle; trading evenly lets his Q outheal you.

edits.before: Track Taric’s Cosmic Radiance: The delayed invulnerability erases your teamfight damage — burst before it lands or wait it out. It’s down or you don’t go.
edits.after: Track Taric's Cosmic Radiance: it erases your burst if mistimed — land it first or wait it out. Dazzle also cancels a channeled R; cast only once his E is spent.
